name: EFG
title: Enterprise Firewall
summary: 1U 25G enterprise firewall: 12.5 Gbps IPS, 500+ devices/5,000+ clients, Shadow Mode HA, dual hot-swap PSUs.

extra.client_note: Performance may be degraded with advanced gateway features (e.g., Traffic Identification)

gotchas: Hosts only the Network app — no Protect/Access/Talk; cameras/doors need a separate console (UNVR / Cloud Key / UCG-Fiber).
Only 6 ports total (2x 2.5G RJ45, 2x SFP+, 2x SFP28): plan an aggregation/core switch (USW-Pro-Aggregation) behind it.
SFP+/SFP28 ports ship empty — budget for modules or DACs.
True HA (Shadow Mode/VRRP) needs a second EFG.
Single-user WireGuard/Teleport tops out ~1.2 Gbps and IPsec site-to-site ~580 Mbps per tunnel — far below the 12.5 Gbps IPS figure.
Overkill below ~multi-Gbps WAN / hundreds of devices — UCG-Fiber covers 5 Gbps IPS for $279.
not_for: anyone wanting Protect on the gateway
